trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum unlocks on its own. Use the roadmap to work through the story first, then the strands, activities and cleanup.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the story, so this unlocks naturally at the start.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Before the chapter ends, meditate at the Chapter 1 balcony spot — it is the one missable moment in the game (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Story trophies cannot be missed — just keep playing the main missions in order.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Two confirmed side trophies open up in this chapter: Capital Offense (after Key Cloner) and Bad Luck, I Guess (after Credit Check).

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. After this chapter only the final mission stands between you and the gold story trophy.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. It unlocks once Chapter 4 is complete; there is no choice to make — play it through to the credits.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 1. Follow the mission markers; no special preparation is needed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 2. It is a story heist — play it through and the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play in Chapter 2. Story mission, unmissable — it unlocks when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners in Chapter 2. Keep following the story missions in order and it will come up.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 2, at Vice City International Airport. A story mission — no extra steps.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 2. Story mission, unmissable — finish it and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: finish the story, all stranger strands, and every activity, collectible and challenge count. The 100% Checklist page lists the real numbers the game tracks — 200/277 vehicles, 100/255 animals, 70/80 challenges, 300/397 stunts — so work through them last.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, airtime and near-misses in vehicles all count. Chase stunt jumps around Leonida; the 100% page tracks 300 of 397 stunt jumps found, so keep jumping past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: races, fishing, shooting range, arcade, bowling, drone races, meditation, stunt jumps and more. Just sample one of each — you do not need to win or finish them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Take your time, aim for accuracy over speed, and replay any challenge you miss gold on — challenges can be retried.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's line first with a slow run, then race it for the win; every location counts separately.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each distinct race counts once, so spread your wins across the map instead of repeating one favourite. Street, off-road and water races all count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish the challenge spot, match the bait to what is biting, and reel steadily — beating Cal is about landing the bigger catch, not speed.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play any arcade game through to its end. Walk up to an arcade cabinet in Vice City, start a game and finish it — no high score needed.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's stranger strand. Stranger strands unlock as you explore Leonida — follow Andy's missions to the last one.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's stranger strand. Work through Kenton's missions in order; the strand ends with this one.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's stranger strand. Follow Billy's missions across Leonida to the finale.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of them, so find three more strangers on the map and finish their strands too.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's stranger strand. Play Randy's missions in order until the strand closes.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's stranger strand. Follow Tyrone's missions to their end.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. MISSABLE: one spot is on a Chapter 1 balcony — meditate there during Chapter 1, before the story moves on, or the spot locks away and the trophy can be missed. The other 17 spots stay open all game.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret's strand. Track the animal Bret names — approach quietly, take the shot cleanly, and bring the hunt back to him.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden all over Leonida — in shops, houses and out in the wild. Track your sets on the 100% page and sweep one region at a time.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 locations. Open it wherever the prompt appears — landmarks, shops and viewpoints all count — and keep a running tally until you hit 100.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the small tasks scattered through the game — the 100% page tracks 70 of 80 found — so keep clearing them as you play and mop up the rest during cleanup.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose the cops and escape. Break line of sight, duck into an alley or a car park, and stay hidden until the stars clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your Wanted Level. Pick three shops close together, hit them fast one after another, and keep the cops from ever spotting you.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Just drive or ride anything new — the game logs each model once. The 100% page tracks 200 of 277 vehicles found, so vary your rides instead of sticking to one car.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group to bunch up, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the kills before the meter runs out — a gang shootout is the easiest place to line it up.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — grab a plane on the runway and take off without a flight plan. The airport is guarded, so go in fast and get airborne before security closes in.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get behind the controls of a Rhino tank. Rhinos show up at military spots and high Wanted Levels — steal one and take it for a drive.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — mask up, avoid the cameras and the staff's sightlines, grab the goods and slip out before anyone raises the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape each time. Plan the getaway first — a fast car parked close by — then crack the vault, grab the cash and outrun the response.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush a truck on a quiet road, crack it open, take the cash and lose the heat before the cops box you in.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive every road and visit every corner of the map — Vice City, the Keys, the swamps and the small towns — until each area is logged as visited.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Find one operation per gang across Leonida, hit it, and move on to the next gang's turf.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: CONFIRMED 20 Nov 2026. Head to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and order an Apple Martini. The trophy pops once the drink is served with the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: CONFIRMED 20 Nov 2026. After Key Cloner in Chapter 3, steal the blue Banshee from the south Vice City showroom, then smash your way out through the glass in classic style.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Head to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a game — follow through on your throw. One full game is all it takes.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Build your partnership's public appeal through the story — the official description names no specific step, so keep playing the partnership missions and side content and it unlocks as your following grows.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make story choices — PSN tracks a count toward 500, so keep choosing whenever the story offers a decision. The official description names no single choice; it is earned by playing through the branching moments.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: CONFIRMED 20 Nov 2026. After Credit Check in Chapter 3, rob Little Cuba Payday Loans as Lucia solo, then escape on foot — no getaway car. The second attempt is the charm.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: CONFIRMED 20 Nov 2026. After 2AM, alone, find the UFO easter egg on the road northwest of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Go solo, go late, and look up.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: CONFIRMED 20 Nov 2026. On a bike, kick 10 pedestrians in the Square within 60 seconds — a melee drive-by. Line up a busy stretch, keep the bike moving, and kick as you pass.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — pass them to your contacts to clean them, and keep laundering until the total hits $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothes, food, ammo and car mods all count — spend as you play and the total climbs on its own.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Save up, then buy every garage on the market — each one counts toward the total.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find a vehicle, open the app and register it — repeat with 10 different vehicles.
